shared_elements: profile figures arranged in a single row
repeated figures of similar size and posture forming a horizontal register
justification: Both are stone bas-reliefs whose figures are shown in strict profile and repeated at regular intervals along a horizontal register, and both use a plain raised band to divide the field. But A is a tall vertical pillar with stacked, unrelated animal motifs carved in a coarse, rounded, sketchy manner, while B is a single continuous frieze of human figures in a procession rendered with fine, controlled modelling of drapery, hair and headgear.
